title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: changing date or vendor closes open groups
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Vendors Y and W both have unpaid bills.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Unpaid Invoices" in the left list.
  3. Open vendor Y's group.
  4. Set the date chip to yesterday.
  5. Read the groups.
  6. Open vendor Y's group.
  7. Pick vendor W in the Vendor chip.
  8. Read the groups.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 5:

  • all groups closed.

Step 8:

  • all groups closed.

Why this matters: A changed filter is a new list.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-payable/ApUnpaidInvoicesReport.vue:363-373. V1 code, quoted: `watch([() => asOfDate.value, () => selectedVendorId.value ?? null, ...], () => { expandedKeys.value = new Set(); });`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-156) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.
